hypothesis: Preloading a skill raises the pass rate on its own contract probes (all kinds pooled) by at least 0.15 versus the same Hermes turn without the skill.
decision_rule: Units: (skill, probe, rep) paired pass difference with_skill minus without_skill; units where either arm did not run are excluded. Cluster = (skill, probe); statistic = mean of 40 cluster means; seeded percentile bootstrap over clusters. Pass iff excluded/units <= max_notrun AND lower bound of the (1 - alpha) interval > 0 AND mean >= min_effect. Excluded fraction above max_notrun => NotRun. Otherwise Fail, which closes this experiment_id. Secondary (descriptive only, no decision): per-skill and per-probe-kind pass counts.
